text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, Special Week said
there was somewhere she wanted to stop by, so I followed along...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Here it is, right here!
This rental shop is where I wanted to go.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "I wanted to watch some older race footage as a reference for the future."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, which one should I borrow today?
"Tokyo Racecourse Highlights" sounds good, but I'm also curious about "Nakayama Racecourse Highlights"...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Which one do you recommend, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll go borrow it right away!
Ah, and the Suzuka-san special feature DVD as well...

After watching the "Tokyo Racecourse Highlights" she borrowed,
Special Week seemed to have gained some kind of insight.
